snippet.title: Avatar Warfare Trailer
snippet.description:
Join 15 of your friends or enemies as you take your Avatar into the intense online paintball battle of Avatar Warfare. Brought to you by the makers of the bestselling games CastleMiner Z and Avatar Laser Wars. Customize your character as you progress though levels, climb the online score boards and unlock new weapons, perks and tag-streaks.

Coming to Xbox Live Indie Games
